column1: # Per-assay binding-partner grouping for BindingGYM, used to build H3-DDG's thermodynamic cycle.
#   DDGPredictor.calc_thermodynamic_cycle computes  complex_energy - sum(energy of each mutated
#   "chain" in isolation).  In H3-DDG's SKEMPI path a "chain" is not one PDB chain but one SIDE of
#   each side into a single chain_nb (0/1), and MPNNPaddingCollate then uses chain_encoding_all =
#   chain_nb + 1 to build the per-side isolated copies.  BindingGYM ships no such annotation, so the
#   two sides are declared here, once, explicitly.
# HOW side0 / side1 WERE DERIVED (all verified against the data, not guessed)
#   * side0 = the protein named FIRST in DMS_id (the mutated protein); side1 = its partner.
#   * For 21 of 25 assays side0 is exactly the set of chains that ever carry a mutation.
#   * Antibody/Fab partners occupy TWO PDB chains that are one protein, so they are grouped:
#   * The 4 Z-domain assays are synthetic-coevolution studies in which BOTH partners are mutated,
#     so "chains that ever carry a mutation" spans both sides and cannot define the split; there
#     each protein is a single chain, so the sides are simply A | B.
#   * Every structure's chain set equals its chain_id set (checked: no bystander chains), so nothing
# Chain lengths (from wildtype_sequence) are given in `note` as the audit trail.

column4: side0=4D5 Fab: A light 214 + B heavy 220; side1=HER2 607
